CreateTraceAnnotation appends a note to a trace or observation
ListTraceAnnotations lists notes for a trace

UpsertCustomColumn creates or updates a custom column definition.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: GetTraceLogsRequest requests the log records correlated to a trace.

post.summary: CreateCustomObservation appends a user/API observation to a trace
BatchCreateCustomObservations appends several user/API observations
ListCustomObservations lists user/API observations for a trace
UpdateTraceOverlay appends a new overlay version for a trace
GetTraceOverlay retrieves the latest user/API overlay for a trace
GetPerformanceBreakdown retrieves detailed performance analysis
GetResourceUtilization retrieves resource usage over time
GetRichTrace retrieves a Langfuse-compatible trace with full details
ListRichTraces retrieves Langfuse-compatible traces with filtering
CreateScore creates a new score for a trace
DeleteScore deletes a score
GetTraceScores retrieves all scores for a trace
AddSemanticMapping adds an attribute-key alias for a field.
DeleteSemanticMapping removes an attribute-key alias for a field.

v1ClassificationRule.description:
ClassificationRule assigns kind to spans whose name is LIKE pattern. pattern
is a SpanName LIKE pattern (e.g. "retriever.%"); kind is the label shown in
the Type column.

id.description:
Optional client-supplied id. SDKs use this so nested custom spans can
reference parent observations before the parent write has completed.

v1CustomColumnDef.description:
CustomColumnDef is a user-defined trace column. value_type is one of
string|number|bool|date; source is one of metadata_path|attribute_path|
score_name; source_ref is the dotted metadata path, span-attribute key, or
score name depending on source.

v1CustomObservation.description:
CustomObservation is a user/API-authored observation appended to a trace.
It renders alongside raw spans but is marked by source and author metadata.

v1EnhancedObservation.title: EnhancedObservation extends RichObservation with workflow and performance data

observationId.title: If specified, breakdown for single observation

v1GetTraceByIDRequest.title: GetTraceByIDRequest requests all spans for a specific trace

v1GetTraceByIDResponse.title: GetTraceByIDResponse returns all spans for a trace

sessionId.description:
Optional: when set, log records carrying this session id (in any of the
recognised session attribute keys) within the trace window are included
even if they don't carry the trace id.

v1GetTraceLogsRequest.description: GetTraceLogsRequest requests the log records correlated to a trace.

v1GetTraceLogsResponse.description: GetTraceLogsResponse returns the correlated log records in time order.

v1GetTraceRequest.title: GetTraceRequest requests a single aggregated Trace by ID

v1GetTraceResponse.title: GetTraceResponse returns a single aggregated Trace

v1GetTraceTreeRequest.title: GetTraceTreeRequest requests a hierarchical tree structure

v1GetTraceTreeResponse.title: GetTraceTreeResponse returns the root of the span tree

v1ObservationIO.title: ObservationIO represents input/output data for an observation

llmTimeToFirstTokenNs.title: Time to first token for LLM calls

activeObservations.title: IDs of observations active at this time

v1Score.title: Score represents a quality/evaluation score for a trace or observation

v1SemanticMapping.description:
SemanticMapping aliases a tenant attribute key into a typed field. field is
one of model|provider|session|user|cost|input|output|input_tokens|
output_tokens|total_tokens; attr_key is the tenant's span-attribute name.

events.title: Events that occurred during the span

v1Span.title: Span represents a single span in a distributed trace

v1SpanEvent.title: SpanEvent represents an event that occurred during a span's lifetime

v1SpanTreeNode.title: SpanTreeNode represents a span with its children in a hierarchical tree

v1StepPerformance.title: StepPerformance represents performance for a single step

perMessageTokens.title: Estimated tokens per message in request

v1TokenBreakdown.title: TokenBreakdown represents comprehensive token usage breakdown

v1TokenDetails.title: TokenDetails represents detailed breakdown of token usage per category

threadId.description:
Conversational thread id, distinct from session_id. A session is a
product-level grouping (often a user-visible chat session); a thread is
the conversational continuation within or across sessions. Langfuse
conflates these via sessionId; we keep them separate so users can
observe multi-turn flows independently of session boundaries.

traceKinds.description:
Trace kinds present in the trace, e.g. ["agent"], ["workflow", "agent"],
["agent", "sandbox"]. Derived from the span taxonomy so the traces list can
show what a trace actually is (agent run, workflow, sandbox work, a combo)
instead of a coarse chat/embeddings method. Empty for a plain gateway call.

customColumns.description:
Resolved values for the tenant's user-defined custom columns, keyed by the
column key. Lets the traces table render dimensions a tenant defined
(e.g. a metadata field) instead of only our fixed columns.

isOperational.description:
True for operational/noise traces: no model, no tokens, no cost, and no
recognized execution kind (e.g. tenant health checks, external interaction
wrappers). Hidden from the list by default; a toggle can show them.

v1Trace.title: Trace represents a trace summary with aggregated data

v1TraceAnnotation.description: TraceAnnotation is an append-only note attached to a trace or observation.

field.title: logical esql field id: model, provider, user, session, thread, correlation, status, tool.name, tokens.total, or metadata.<key>

v1TraceLogRecord.description: TraceLogRecord is one OTLP log record correlated to a trace.

v1TraceOverlay.description:
TraceOverlay contains user/API-authored presentation changes for a trace.
It is stored separately from raw OTEL spans so runtime telemetry remains
immutable and auditable.

v1TraceView.description:
TraceView is a saved traces-table view. config_json is an opaque blob owned
by the client: { visibleColumns, filters, sort, ... }.
